<analysis>@EnableCircuitBreaker was deprecated in Spring Cloud 2020 and removed in Spring Cloud 2022; circuit breakers are auto-configured from the classpath. The script removes the import and the annotation and leaves a MIGRATION-TODO: the Hystrix starter is still declared (EOL), its port to Resilience4j is a follow-up.</analysis>
<script>
import re

IMPORT = re.compile(r"^import\s+org\.springframework\.cloud\.client\.circuitbreaker\.EnableCircuitBreaker;\n", re.M)
ANNOTATION = re.compile(r"^([ \t]*)@EnableCircuitBreaker[ \t]*\n", re.M)
TODO = ("// MIGRATION-TODO: @EnableCircuitBreaker removed (Spring Cloud 2022+ auto-configures circuit breakers); "
        "Hystrix is still declared - move to Resilience4j\n")

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        text = p.read(path)
        new = IMPORT.sub("", text)
        todo = "" if "MIGRATION-TODO: @EnableCircuitBreaker" in new else TODO
        new = ANNOTATION.sub(lambda m: m.group(1) + todo, new)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: @EnableCircuitBreaker removed")
        else:
            p.log(f"{path}: nothing to change")
</script>
